assessment: The design satisfies direct saved empty-action creation and one-request caller creation without a separate temporary entity or invented text. Restricting blank acceptance to action titles protects catalog/ref contracts. Initial tags can use existing delta/identity/Undo paths in one atomic batch; SQL NOT NULL permits empty string, so no migration is necessary. Deterministic selected-context creation and English disabled reasons prevent silent Inbox fallback. Result-aware confirmed identity selection, exact unknown-request retention and the clean out-of-filter route address pending navigation and recovery hazards.
implementation_conditions: Separate actionTitle from generic nonempty text. Cover add/edit/rename/structure action titles and keep capture_intent caller-title, catalog names and structure refs nonempty.
Validate initial tag_ids ownership/existence/uniqueness/UUID shape and add associations plus identity markers at the owner revision within the existing atomic CAS batch. No second action_tag write.
Shared real-store tests must cover initial-tag failure rollback, competing creation, exact replay after lost response, owner isolation and association Undo conflict/ABA detection.

Require generated resolved.actions identity proof before success callback or clearing unknown. A full write response must contain the matching action; operation_status is never accepted as a snapshot.
Preserve pre-accept group acknowledgments while focusing created Title only after full snapshot merge. Receipt-applied refresh loss or absent target retains identity and explicit recovery feedback.
Keep clean created action reachable outside current navigation after inspector closure until superseded or visible; route uses ID and current full snapshot only.
No precreation Title/Notes/capture UI; Untitled is display fallback only. Blank saved records survive close/navigation/refresh without automatic deletion.

Freeze creation context while pending. Exact selected Project/Tag IDs remain destination even with descendants expansion; no inherited assignment, inferred future date or arbitrary perspective inference.
Keep all other drafts, IME/caret, reviewed proposals, revision/replay/Undo semantics intact; test ordinary success, applied receipt and identical retry all select the same returned ID.
limitations: Design approval does not establish implementation, browser appearance, real-host acceptance or deployed schema state.
No runtime kernel success receipt claimed.
